title: Operating model decisions under delivery pressure
discussion_question: What operating model should a growing technology organization adopt when demand is rising faster than its coordination capacity?
supplementary_materials: Make the tradeoffs concrete. Address ownership boundaries, escalations, on-call load, release governance, staffing limits, process overhead, and where a technology org should deliberately standardize versus keep local autonomy.
output_contract: Respond in three short sections named diagnosis, operating recommendation, and concrete first moves.
assumptions_and_constraints: Assume headcount and budget are constrained, customer delivery cannot pause for long, and recommendations should stay consistent with the persona's own lens.
